In the Media

News stories, radio and podcast episodes, talks, and books that feature Dr. Tory Eisenlohr-Moul and the research of the CLEAR Lab on hormones, the menstrual cycle, PMDD, and suicide risk.

About this page. This archive is created and maintained with Claude AI, which finds the coverage and writes the short summaries. Please confirm all content by visiting the original article.

How this updates

Every Monday a check searches the web for new coverage of Dr. Eisenlohr-Moul's work in news, radio, podcasts, video and books, adds anything new, and redraws this page. New items carry a yellow New tag for 30 days.

Coverage

Web search finds most online stories and episodes but misses paywalled print and radio that was never posted. Red tags mark pieces where she is quoted, interviewed or a guest; grey tags mark pieces that cite the lab's research. A dashed tag means her name has not yet been confirmed in the text.
